create.name: Puma Fredy Quispe Singona
create.bio:
From Chinchero, near Cusco in Peru, Puma Fredy Quispe Singona is an Andean medicine carrier who keeps the Rainbow Lineage traditions of his village's Inca people. When he was six he was struck by lightning, and afterwards his grandfather, the late Don Maximo, took him on for training. He has also studied the huachuma lineages of the Peruvian coast and the ayahuasca lineage of the Shipibo people in the Amazon. Since he was 15 he has spoken at international gatherings, and he has led meetings for spiritual leaders and young Indigenous leaders.

Andean cosmology, ceremony and the mesa, the portable altar of the Andes, are at the centre of his teaching, always grounded in deep respect for Pachamama. In Chinchero he founded the Noqan Kani Global Community Center, a place where locals and visitors can learn Andean ways and nature-based wisdom, and he runs his online mesa programmes from there. He is a co-founder of Pumadventures, which takes groups to Peru's sacred sites, and on The Shift Network he has taught many self-paced courses on Andean shamanic practice, spirit animals and the Chakana, or Andean cross.

courses.title: Sacred Journey to Peru December 2026
courses.description: A ten-day group journey through the Sacred Valley and Cusco led by Puma with Stephen Dinan, Master Mingtong Gu and other guests. The programme includes ceremonies at sacred sites, Andean teachings and live ceremonial music. Price is per person and excludes airfare.

courses.title: Kuntur Mesa
courses.description: Noqan Kani's original six-month mesa programme, for beginners and experienced mesa carriers alike. Monthly recorded teachings are paired with live integration sessions with Puma, working with the Andean medicine bundle and the energy of the condor. Runs each year from September to March.

courses.title: Pukara Mesa
courses.description: A year-long mesa programme working with the Pukara Apus and the cosmic forces of the Andean tradition, offered in yearly cycles since 2021. It combines twelve recorded teachings with twelve live integration sessions in a small, committed circle. The next cycle begins in January 2027 (waitlist).

courses.title: Chakana Portals
courses.description: A six-month online journey across the Chakana, the stepped Andean cross, treating each step as a portal of consciousness and service. Each month brings three recorded videos and one live integration with Puma, anchored in mesa practice. The cycle starts in March 2027.

courses.title: Daily Incan Shamanic Manifestation Practices
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course built around the seven ley lines of the Incan cosmovision. Puma teaches daily Andean practices for connecting with Pachamama and the cosmic father and mother, with a focus on spiritual growth and the flow of abundance.

courses.title: Deepen Your Healing Capacity With the Chakana & Your Personal Mesa
courses.description: An eleven-module self-paced Shift Network course, including an introductory programme, on building and working with a personal Andean altar. It covers rituals that bring the powers of the Chakana into the mesa and call on allies of the Earth and cosmos.

courses.title: Animal Spirit Medicine From the Andes
courses.description: A thirteen-module self-paced Shift Network course on hampi huywa, the healing animals of the Andean tradition. Each module introduces a new animal through shamanic practice, meditation and ritual.

courses.title: Shamanic Rituals to Embody the Healing Power of Spirit Animals
courses.description: An eight-module self-paced Shift Network course introducing a different spirit animal in each class. Through Andean shamanic practices, group exercises, meditations and rituals, students learn to call on Mother Earth and the animal powers.

courses.title: Andean Shamanic Rituals to Synchronize Your Life Path With the Cosmos
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced Shift Network course of shamanic journeys and rituals from the Andean tradition. Puma shares the prophecies of his lineage about the present shift in consciousness and practices for living in harmony with nature.

courses.title: Andean Shamanic Journeys & Rituals to Align With the Divine Feminine for Strength & Purpose
courses.description: An eleven-module on-demand Shift Network course on the seven starlight rays of the Pleiades in Andean cosmology. Through rituals, journeys and ceremonies it explores the sacred feminine on Earth and within the soul. Registration includes the Synchronize Your Life Path course.

The email (iam@noqankani.com) is the Noqan Kani community centre address shown in the site footer, not a personal one.
No videos from his own channel (none found); all are interviews or talks on other channels where he is the main speaker.
Pukara Mesa (January 2027) and Chakana Portals (March 2027) have no exact start day published, so dates are left null and the month is given in the description.

Sacred Journey to Peru is co-led with Master Mingtong Gu, Stephen Dinan and others on The Shift Network; Dr. Marie Mbouni (also in this sprint, plan marie-mbouni.json) is on the guest faculty; Mingtong Gu is not in the queue or existing listings.
